title: External inventory allocation projection
description: Read-only allocation whitelist with stable UUID external order and order-item identity. Only allocations created by the calling service principal are listed.

source_object_type.description: Approved external order lifecycle identity kind; shipping references are not exposed.

source_object_id.description: Stable order_item_id for EXTERNAL_ORDER_ITEM or order_id for EXTERNAL_ORDER; never synthesized.

source_object_no.description: Display-only source number; never used as lifecycle identity.

allocated_quantity.description: Decimal string written without trailing zeros here (5, 0.5), unlike reserve and release lines, which always carry three decimals (5.000). Compare as decimals, not as strings.

status.description: Allocation lifecycle: RESERVED -> CONFIRMED -> ISSUED, and RESERVED or CONFIRMED -> RELEASED (warehouse release, hold expiry, or consumer self-release). ISSUED is terminal: the warehouse issued the goods through a sales issue document linked to this allocation. It adds no field to the projection; confirmed_at keeps the confirmation time. Consumers must tolerate a status value they do not know. See enums/ops/inventory-allocation-status.yaml and state-machines/ops/allocation-state.md.
